screening_reasoning: A review of 50 years of weed detection/recognition research for large-scale cropping systems; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
Counting in-situ rice seedlings from UAV images uses a deep fully convolutional regression network to estimate density maps; a counting/regression task rather than pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.
A paper on sustainable crop protection via robotics and AI within an Agriculture 5.0 framework; a positional/review-style contribution without a primary segmentation benchmark.
A bibliometric review of UAV use in precision agriculture and viticulture; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A review of transfer learning applications in agriculture; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A survey of big data and machine learning for environment and water management; secondary literature in a non-crop/weed domain.
Comparative semantic segmentation of grape clusters (FCN, U-Net, DeepLabv3+) targets fruit in a viticulture domain, outside crop/weed segmentation; acquisition is not UAV.
A survey of IoT developments in agriculture; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A review of machine learning and deep learning models in agriculture; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A systematic review of deep learning applications in lettuce production; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A systematic analysis/review of deep learning for crop yield prediction; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A review of precision chemical weed management strategies including a CNN spot-sprayer design; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A review of ground and aerial phenotyping platforms for high-throughput crop trait estimation; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A review of remote sensing and machine learning for crop phenotyping with an emphasis on strawberry farming; secondary literature in a fruit domain.
A PRISMA systematic review of IoT and AI smart sensing technologies in agriculture; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
Weed recognition using five deep CNNs evaluates whole-image crop/weed classification, not pixel-level segmentation; classification task outside scope.
A field-agnostic crop monitoring system using instance segmentation operates on ground robots across arable farmland and glasshouse, not UAV aerial imagery.

Detection and counting of maize leaves from UAV RGB images combines Mask R-CNN and YOLOv5s to count individual plant leaves; a plant-organ leaf-counting/phenotyping task rather than crop/weed segmentation.
A review of image processing techniques for leaf pest and disease recognition; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A review of computer-vision-based phenotyping from a machine learning perspective; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
WE3DS is an RGB-D semantic segmentation dataset (soil, 7 crops, 10 weeds) acquired with a ground-level stereo RGB-D sensor under natural light, not UAV aerial imagery.
No abstract is retrievable, so quantitative segmentation results and modalities cannot be confirmed; the lesion-recognition task is also a disease-severity domain.
A review of the YOLO object-detection algorithm applied in agriculture; secondary literature and an object-detection task, not a segmentation benchmark.

Deep CNNs (U-Net, SegNet, FCN, DeepLabv3+) are evaluated for pixel-level crop/weed discrimination on UAS datasets, with DeepLabv3+ reaching 84.3% classification accuracy; satisfies UAV crop/weed segmentation with pixel accuracy, though one of two datasets is from a field robot.
A review of drone technology for farm monitoring and pesticide spraying; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
